# Living Restorations
> Ecological design and coastal restoration services in Tampa Bay, St. Petersburg, Sarasota, and Clearwater, Florida. FANN credentialed, Florida Master Naturalist since 2014, ISNetworld B-grade contractor rating. Specializes in FDEP-compliant native planting, living shoreline installation, dune restoration, and invasive species removal for residential, commercial, and waterfront development projects.
Living Restorations is founded and led by Kiamesha Wray, one of the first FANN (Florida Association of Native Nurseries) credentialed professionals in Florida. Kiamesha has been a Florida Master Naturalist since 2014 and holds an ISNetworld B-grade contractor rating. Her work has been featured in Homes and Gardens magazine (November 2025). The company serves waterfront developers, general contractors, and property owners across Pinellas, Hillsborough, Sarasota, and Manatee counties.
## Main Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.livingrestorations.com/): Ecological design and coastal restoration services for Florida properties
- [For Waterfront Developers](https://www.livingrestorations.com/for-developers): FDEP-compliant ecological subcontracting for waterfront development projects in Tampa Bay, Sarasota, and Clearwater — dune restoration, living shorelines, native littoral planting, CCCL and SWFWMD compliance
- [For General Contractors](https://www.livingrestorations.com/for-contractors): FANN-credentialed ecological subcontracting for GC bid teams — ISNetworld rated, documentation-ready, available for RFP teaming on coastal restoration projects
- [Events](https://www.livingrestorations.com/events): Upcoming events and community gatherings hosted by or in partnership with Living Restorations
- [Living Shoreline Summer Fundraiser](https://www.livingrestorations.com/shoreline): Fundraiser event on July 30, 2026 at The Study, St. Petersburg, benefiting living shoreline restoration in the Tampa Bay region
## Services
- Invasive species removal
- Dune system design and installation
- Coastal habitat restoration
- Living shoreline design and installation
- Native plant sourcing
- Environmental design consulting
- Maintenance and monitoring
## Events
- Living Shoreline Summer Fundraiser — Thursday, July 30, 2026, 6:00–9:00 PM at The Study Wine & Bourbon Tasting Lounge, 3100 3rd Avenue North, St. Petersburg, FL 33713. Tickets are $20 ($10 tax-deductible). The evening includes a complimentary glass of champagne, a charcuterie spread, close-up magic by John Williams, a talk on the Cockroach Bay living shoreline restoration by Tom Ries, a raffle, and a silent auction of an original Cockroach Bay painting created live by West Evans. Proceeds benefit Ecosphere Restoration Institute's living shoreline maintenance and monitoring in the Tampa Bay region. Tickets: https://donorbox.org/events/948209/steps/choose_tickets

## Permit Expertise
- FDEP Environmental Resource Permit compliance
- Coastal Construction Control Line (CCCL) — Chapter 161
- SWFWMD Stormwater Management Permit — native littoral planting
- USACE Section 404 and Section 10
- Marine Turtle Habitat Protection (FWC)
